title: Composition of the actual ambient coefficient maps
statement: Let ell be prime, E a finite extension of Q_ell, f:X→Y and g:Y→Z arbitrary scheme maps, and s a finite exponent or the entire ringed sequence site [lem-sf-ambient-pullback-site-constructions]. For the actual coefficient adjunction maps c_f=ringMap(f), the mate alpha=ringComp(f,g) of the canonical direct-image comparison satisfies c_fg=alpha;ringPull(f)(c_g);c_f. The equation is on the whole ringed site before evaluation.

source.place: Tags 03D3 and 03EL; sites.tex 03CB; sites-cohomology.tex 06YN, 06YS, 07A4, 0G7E and 0G7D. Specialized construction and proof from the ambient coherence argument.

proof.text: Check that ringUnit(g) followed by g_* ringUnit(f) and ringPushComp(f,g) equals ringUnit(fg). At a finite level this follows by testing on the constant presheaf sheafification unit and its naturality at the fibre-product comparison. At sequence level the comparison is vertical at the same index, so its restriction is exactly the corresponding finite coefficient restriction.

For abstract adjunctions, rewrite the hom bijection of the inverse compositor using unit_conjugateEquiv_symm and naturality. Apply comp_homEquiv and the two naturality equations for adjuncts. The adjunct of the asserted composite is precisely the direct-image composite from the first step; injectivity proves the coefficient equation.

lean.statement:
theorem ringMap_composition {X Y Z : Scheme.{t}}
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z) (s : Option ℕ) :
    ringMap ell E (f ≫ g) s =
      (ringComp f g s).hom.app (coefficients ell E Z s) ≫
        (ringPull f s).map (ringMap ell E g s) ≫ ringMap ell E f s
